remarks: Welcome to 321 Chestnut Hill Rd, Stamford, CT! This all in one floor (sprawling ranch) single-family home offers 4 spacious bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and an impressive 4,152 sq ft of living space, all nestled on a beautifully landscaped 1.02-acre lot. Recently updated with brand-new central air (with warranty), a new roof, and new siding, this home is move-in ready and built to last.  Step inside to discover gleaming hardwood floors throughout and generously sized living areas perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The charm continues with three elegant wood-burning fireplaces, creating cozy and inviting spaces throughout the home. Whether you're hosting gatherings or enjoying a quiet night in, this home offers the warmth, comfort, and space you've been dreaming of.  This is truly a must-see property-schedule your private tour today!
